methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: Using this cloud platform for home appliances could help the manufacturers to promote energy efficiency programs on smart appliances.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Exclusive focus on a residential washing machine/home appliance without an industrial component.

paper_type.evidence_quote: In this study, a cloud computing platform is established to measure the washing machine energy consumption parameters and calculate energy savings which consist of load sensors and fuzzy control.

stage1.notes: Exclusive appliance-level residential application; no industrial production case is demonstrated.
